notes.title: Trading cards have been added to the game!!
Added Korean localization.
notes.notes:
Korean language has been added to the game. We thank Grabbit for the translation.

Minor bugs fixed

notes.title: Adding a disable for camera shake
notes.notes: We noticed that a lot of people were complaining about a lot of camera shake, so we added an option to turn it off.

notes.title: Chinese localization bug fix
notes.notes:
On behalf of the whole team, I would like to apologize to the Chinese players for the localization error.
Simplified Chinese has been rewritten. Support for traditional Chinese has been added.
If you find any new errors or inaccuracies in the translation, please report them in the appropriate discussion.
